---
title: "Assessment of regionally elevated genes in the Brain"
author: "Jacob Flewitt"
---
Data was collected on the number of genes that appeared regionally elevated in the brains of humans, rats and pigs. I wish to calculate the number of genes which are regionally elevated in the forebrain of humans, rats and pigs.
```{r}
sum_in_humans <- (180 + 83 + 57 + 110)
sum_in_rats <- (55 + 185 + 60 + 98)
sum_in_pigs <- (109 + 157 + 31 + 45)
print (sum_in_humans)
print (sum_in_rats)
print (sum_in_pigs)
```
Humans had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression, with 430. This is in comparison to rats with 398 and pigs with 342
